title: Full-tree code review and fixes

scope.method: Subsystem-sharded correctness A/C/D/E/F/G and quality passes; independent candidate verification; one fresh gap sweep; completion passes for initially sampled modules; independent reviews of the applied patches. Three concurrent reviewer slots required waves. Removed-hunk angle B was inapplicable to a clean whole-tree target.
scope.limits: Production modules and relevant callers/tests were inspected across the repository. This is not a proof of bug absence; every visual selector and every test assertion was not independently reread. No dependency CVE or third-party source audit was performed.

findings.summary: CI source transfer could include private local files
findings.failure_scenario: A whole-checkout rsync selected synthetic credentials.json, cert.pem and agent configuration outside its denylist.
findings.fix: Stage an approved Git source inventory; reject sensitive names, credential folders, external or escaping symlinks and symlinked ancestors; preserve runner caches.
findings.evidence: Synthetic local rsync reproduction; source selection and actual ci_mac.sh through stub Git/SSH/rsync tests. No real transfer.

findings.summary: Corrupt direct-mode PID records could become group-wide signal targets
findings.failure_scenario: An overflowing unsigned PID with an empty saved start time resolved despite an empty ps result; conversion could produce a negative pid_t.
findings.fix: Reject zero, pid_t overflow, empty saved/observed start times before returning a target.
findings.evidence: Actual running_pid regression failed before and passes after. Invalid stop/signals were deliberately never executed.

findings.summary: Stored history disclosed suffixes of quoted secret values
findings.failure_scenario: A named password containing whitespace retained its second word; ANSI-C escaped quotes exposed another suffix.
findings.fix: Consume the complete quoted/escaped value for storage, including ANSI-C quoting and unfinished values; execution text is untouched.
findings.evidence: Synthetic redaction and actual Sent::add/get regressions; ANSI-C case failed before the final correction and passes after.
findings.followup: 2026-10-31 maintainer review: the fix tracked quotes from the start of the whole text, so an apostrophe earlier in a prompt ("don't", "it's") hid the rest of it in stored history. Quotes now open only at a value's start or after a closed quote; a quote opened inside a value's word is not followed (documented in SECURITY.md). cargo test redaction: prose, outer-quoted assignment, quoted parts, non-ASCII; pragmatic review approved with those tests.

findings.summary: Queued typing could reach another tmux server
findings.failure_scenario: Two servers had the same pane number while an earlier send was pending; batching selected only the first server.
findings.fix: Group by complete pane key and Arc-identical server generation; wake/size only the destination still shown.
findings.evidence: Production Queue regression failed before; actual daemon with local/fake-remote equal-number panes keeps markers separate.

findings.summary: Deferred clipboard work could paste into a different session
findings.failure_scenario: Clipboard permission/read or image conversion began in pane A and resolved after B became shown.
findings.fix: Capture the original pane across every await, image conversion and paste dialog; refuse changed targets.
findings.evidence: Before-fix regression plus Chromium/WebKit wide/phone actual-page checks, same-target happy path and changed-target refusal.

findings.summary: Enter on Cancel could execute a destructive primary action
findings.failure_scenario: The modal capture handler chose Trash even when Cancel or Close held keyboard focus.
findings.fix: Activate the focused choice, trap Tab inside the modal and restore previous focus.
findings.evidence: Real private-panel Cancel/Close sent Trash before; after, no Trash request and the file remains; primary and Escape still work.

findings.summary: A quick-shell confirmation could kill a newly selected shell
findings.failure_scenario: The dialog described QA, but mutable selection changed to QB before confirmation.
findings.fix: Close the captured confirmed resource id.
findings.evidence: Independent actual-code reproduction and browser checks for confirm/cancel after selection changes.

findings.summary: Host replacement retained the previous machine’s Files connection
findings.failure_scenario: Recipe replacement/off/invalid records left the old helper registration; file-watcher reloads did not synchronize host connections.
findings.fix: Stop retired helper/link state, remove invalid servers, keep attach-only updates, refuse off-host reconciliation and sync host records on settings reload.
findings.evidence: Actual private-daemon off/recipe/invalid-record checks changed from stale 200 responses to 404; remote e2e remains functional.

findings.summary: Removing terminum hooks deleted unrelated nested commands
findings.failure_scenario: One matcher entry contained both terminum and a user command; deleting the whole entry discarded both.
findings.fix: Filter only exact matching commands and retain matcher metadata and remaining hooks.
findings.evidence: Actual command-removal flow on synthetic hook files and focused nested-hook regressions failed before/pass after.

findings.summary: Invalid project schemas could be overwritten without recovery backup
findings.failure_scenario: Valid JSON failed schema decoding after the backup validator had already accepted it.
findings.fix: Decode both project and server schemas inside read_or_set_aside, preserving recoverable originals before later writes.
findings.evidence: Invalid-schema backup regression failed before; valid/missing-state roundtrip and subsequent save pass.

findings.summary: A failed checkpoint suppressed all unchanged retries
findings.failure_scenario: The success cache advanced before publication; recovering storage did not retry an identical layout.
findings.fix: Advance the cached checkpoint only after the atomic write succeeds.
findings.evidence: Actual private daemon: deterministic publication failure, storage recovery, then the unchanged two-window checkpoint is saved.

findings.summary: Import overwrote existing settings of the wrong JSON type
findings.failure_scenario: Existing settings containing an array were treated as absent and replaced during import.
findings.fix: Default only for an absent file; refuse incompatible existing JSON without changing its bytes.
findings.evidence: Synthetic import regression failed before; invalid-shape refusal and normal imports pass.

findings.summary: Old helper cleanup could remove a replacement link
findings.failure_scenario: Publication could rename a new link between an old helper’s read-link check and remove.
findings.fix: Serialize publication and conditional deletion with flock on the checked existing directory descriptor; no persistent lock file.
findings.evidence: Separate child test processes prove publication/unlink wait for the lock and old cleanup preserves the newer link; baseline failed.

findings.summary: Stale hook events could erase current session and plan state
findings.failure_scenario: An old SessionEnd or tool event arrived after a new session; accepted identity and later plan effects could also interleave across workers.
findings.fix: Reject mismatched non-start events atomically and serialize acceptance through synchronous turn/plan effects.
findings.evidence: Hook-state and direct hook_on regressions; dispatch barrier bypass failed before and both socket tests pass after.

findings.summary: Restore expanded literal hashes in folders and window names
findings.failure_scenario: A saved literal #S or session format was expanded during reconstruction, changing the window name and cwd.
findings.fix: Share literal tmux-format escaping for restore -c/-n through argv and control transports.
findings.evidence: Real tmux reproduction plus actual restore::make test for both transports and split panes. No command-substitution execution was attempted.

additional_fixes.summary: CLI timeouts left descendants and detached output readers
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: Killing only the immediate shell left its sleep descendant and wait_with_output thread alive.
additional_fixes.fix: Own a process group; collect nonblocking pipes under a deadline, close readers on errors and keep the leader unreaped until pipe EOF before any group signal.
additional_fixes.evidence: Real synthetic descendant failure before; descendant cleanup and both-stream/exit-status checks after. PID reuse was not forced.

additional_fixes.summary: Imported remote workspace keys did not match the Panel namespace
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The inner pane id used the new host alias but the outer web host remained empty or used the old recipe.
additional_fixes.fix: Map both namespace components consistently and preserve root, tabs and expanded folders.
additional_fixes.evidence: Corrected actual import fixture now matches ui/embed pinKey; failed before and passes after.

additional_fixes.summary: Deleting one task could rename the following task
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: A deleted TaskUpdate also contained a subject; the old index now pointed at the next item.
additional_fixes.fix: Apply optional text only to an item still matching the requested task id.
additional_fixes.evidence: Production plan regression failed before and passes after with the following item unchanged.

additional_fixes.summary: A failed filesystem subscription was recorded as installed
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: A transient watch failure entered have; an identical later request never retried it.
additional_fixes.fix: Track successful watch additions only and retry failed additions on later reconciliation.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual reconciliation with an injected first failure proves retry, idempotence and removal behavior.

additional_fixes.summary: The largest sent-history index could panic
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: Unchecked n+1 overflowed before checked_sub, or wrapped into an out-of-bounds index.
additional_fixes.fix: Use newest-first iterator nth without unchecked index arithmetic and preserve the real count.
additional_fixes.evidence: Empty/populated history with usize::MAX: failed before and passes after.

additional_fixes.summary: Unicode lowercasing corrupted search rows and DOM ranges
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: Lowercasing dotted capital I expanded positions; the server selected the next row and the DOM selected the next character or threw.
additional_fixes.fix: Measure server row boundaries in the matching representation and map folded DOM offsets back to original characters.
additional_fixes.evidence: Rust wrapped/repeated/Greek-sigma cases and browser actual DOM ranges; original cases failed before.

additional_fixes.summary: Timed-out searches could not retry the same query
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The error text changed but pending stayed true, suppressing every identical retry.
additional_fixes.fix: Clear pending only for the current timed-out request while retaining stale-response guards.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual-code fake-timer regression and browser retry checks.

additional_fixes.summary: Shell cursor movement counted UTF-16 halves
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: An emoji counted as two editing characters and emitted one extra Left key.
additional_fixes.fix: Share grapheme counting for editing coordinates while retaining physical protocol cell counts.
additional_fixes.evidence: Browser hit-testing emits two Left keys; those exact production-generated keys through a daemon insert X before an emoji in real bash/readline.

additional_fixes.summary: Delayed expansion reopened folders after Collapse all
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: A late locate answer checked only root epoch and ignored cancellation.
additional_fixes.fix: Check expansion generation and current parent visibility before mutation.
additional_fixes.evidence: Deferred production-method regression and actual private-panel delayed backend locate/collapse checks in both browsers and sizes.

additional_fixes.summary: YAML rendered invalid aliases and incorrect scalar text
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: Aliases crossed document boundaries or became strings when undefined; explicit block indent and escaped continuation/blank lines changed values.
additional_fixes.fix: Reset anchors per document, report unresolved aliases, preserve explicit indentation and escaped line semantics including CRLF and extra blank lines.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual parser regressions failed before; parser suite plus independent nested-sequence/blank-line review. Original Source text remains intact.

additional_fixes.summary: Themed destructive-action text had insufficient contrast
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The repository’s dark theme used terminal background as text on ANSI red: about 3.07:1.
additional_fixes.fix: Use shared danger fill/ink tokens, about 6:1, for the destructive primary button in every theme.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual settled screenshots and computed dark/light contrast assertion on the real panel.

additional_fixes.summary: Large-folder lookups bypassed the four-request bound
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: One folder job launched hundreds of per-name requests through Promise.all.
additional_fixes.fix: Bound individual requests globally to four and discard stale-generation work.
additional_fixes.evidence: Independent baseline observed 200 concurrent requests; bounded multi-folder regressions pass.

additional_fixes.summary: Listing benchmark could report FAIL with exit status zero
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The last echo command hid budget failures and the default ten-sample p95 selected rank nine.
additional_fixes.fix: Use nearest-rank p95 and return non-zero when any budget fails; test subprocess cleanup owns its group.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual shell command with deterministic timing/process stand-ins: four baseline assertions failed; current benchmark tests pass.

additional_fixes.failure_scenario: Only successful echoes entered samples, so one fast response could hide many timeouts.
additional_fixes.fix: Count misses as failures, reject empty runs and use the correct percentile.
additional_fixes.evidence: Actual old benchmark code failed two synthetic cases; all echo regressions pass after.

additional_fixes.summary: A promised remote Files assertion never ran
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: A nonexistent optional Terminumd.api method was guarded by hasattr, skipping the assertion unconditionally.
additional_fixes.fix: Use the existing real API helper and execute the check unconditionally.
additional_fixes.evidence: Fake-remote agents runner executes the Files-after-refused-forward check: 22 actual checks.

additional_fixes.summary: The live-parent fixture could outlive its test
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The shell/sleep/tmux pipeline handle was discarded and early cleanup left sleep running.
additional_fixes.fix: Retain the owned process group and end/reap that group on cleanup.
additional_fixes.evidence: Owned pipeline cleanup regression plus actual host-attach runner with 27 checks.

additional_fixes.summary: Panel cleanup could race a still-running daemon
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: SIGTERM was followed immediately by tmux/state removal; the daemon could recreate them while shutting down.
additional_fixes.fix: Await owned-child exit with bounded escalation, recognize signal exits and await cleanup at every caller.
additional_fixes.evidence: Real child shutdown tests and actual private-panel matrix; no test daemon or socket remains.

additional_fixes.summary: Complete remote MCP responses were reported as unavailable
additional_fixes.failure_scenario: The client received a complete HTTP 200 answer with Content-Length 144 (253 raw bytes), then timed out waiting for EOF; the plan or note was already persisted.
additional_fixes.fix: Return at complete Content-Length/chunked framing or a no-body 204/304 head; only close-delimited bodies wait for EOF. Reject incomplete declared bodies and chunk terminators.
additional_fixes.evidence: Original uninstrumented remote-agents runner reproduced repeatedly; client-only diagnostic proved the full response preceded timeout. Actual Unix-socket held-open regression failed before and all six sockhttp tests pass after; unchanged original runner passes22/22 three times on the final optimized binary.

status.resource_audit: All recorded test commands completed; checked test ports closed and known private tmux servers gone. Only the intentionally installed application service is handed to the user.

validation_notes: An early remote test run failed because the debug binary was rebuilt while its older daemon was still running, so newly copied helpers had a different build id. Pinned binary snapshots removed that verification race; the 32-check remote runner then passed.

An initial full test run exposed a private tmux fixture setup conflict in the added two-transport restore regression. Control clients now start only for the control-transport phase; the complete final suite passed with the original assertions intact.
The initial dispatch barrier fixture lacked a Tokio runtime. After fixing the fixture, the meaningful production-path regression failed before the dispatch mutex and passed afterward.

Repeated remote-agents failures (21/22) persisted without concurrent compilation. Optimized client-only failure logging captured complete HTTP 200 Content-Length responses before the client timed out waiting for EOF. This became finding M1 and was fixed; the actual held-open Unix-socket regression failed before and six focused sockhttp tests pass afterward. The relay, time budgets and runner assertions were not weakened.

Full fake-page (1541) and Panel (165) browser suites validate the final UI source; later changes affect only CLI HTTP response completion. The final full unit/Clippy checks and actual daemon/remote/browser rechecks cover the delivered backend.
noticed_not_fixed: No confirmed review finding remains unfixed. Physical-device, real-SSH, watch-exhaustion and dependency-audit coverage limits remain below.
Redaction misses `API_KEY = "x"` (spaces around =), hyphenated names such as `X-API-Key:`, and compact JSON `{"password":"a b"}`; an unclosed quote still hides to the end of the text (spec).
